supersedes_by_appending: data/nfl/evidence_2026-08-22_preseason_board.json recorded benchmark_side NULL for want of an attributable line. That record is not edited (R6); this one supplies the line and fills the benchmark.
book_attribution: SINGLE BOOK, BOTH SIDES. The DraftKings logo is on the board and every market shows both sides from that one book.
PRICE_BASIS: SAME_BOOK_TWO_SIDED — DE-VIG VALID. This is the first same-book two-sided capture of the night and it is materially different from the WNBA aggregator board. The arithmetic confirms the badge: overround +4.75% on the moneyline, +4.62% on the spread, +4.75% on the main total, +6.52% on both SGP alternates. A genuine single-book vig. The WNBA capture two hours earlier carried +0.58% and +0.41%, which is the signature of best-odds shopping across books and is why de-vig was refused there. THE OVERROUND IS THE TEST AND THIS BOARD PASSES IT.

game.book_odds_movement: DK implied chart shows DAL 50% / ARI 50% at capture

MODEL_STATUS: NO NFL MODEL EXISTS. There is no NFL model identity in the registry and no immutable pregame probability card. A valid de-vig produces a MARKET probability; it does not produce an edge, because there is nothing to compare it against. Brier, log loss, model edge and EV remain NULL BY RULE, not omitted by oversight. A valid price basis raises the quality of the market evidence, not the existence of a model.

benchmark_registration.convention: registered NFL benchmark convention — the capture-time market favourite is the benchmark side; a tie grades PUSH and is counted separately
benchmark_registration.basis: ARI is the favourite on both the moneyline (-112 vs -108) and the spread (-1.5)
benchmark_registration.grade_scope: MARKET_BENCHMARK_ONLY. This measures the market, not the model.

SGP_CORRELATION_NOTE: The alternate spread and alternate total are tagged SGP (same-game parlay). Legs inside one game are CORRELATED — a DAL +2.5 cover and an Over 37.5 are not independent events — and books price SGP combinations with a correlation adjustment that is not visible on this screen. The independence multiplication used in the 2026-08-22 parlay screen is defensible ACROSS different games and is NOT valid within one game. Any same-game combination would need the book's own combined price, and even then carries no model view here.
alt_line_juice_note: Both SGP alternates carry +6.52% overround against +4.62-4.75% on the main lines — roughly 40% more vig for moving the number one point.
